# Absent from Chronic

Replication-focused statistical analysis project for work absenteeism using pooled CCHS cycles.

## About This Project

- **Project**: `absent-from-chronic`
- **Goal**: Analyze relationships between chronic conditions and work absenteeism using pooled CCHS 2010–2011 and 2013–2014 cycles.
- **Data source**: CCHS PUMF SPSS files stored in private raw storage.

## Data locations (sanitized)

| Layer | Contents |
|---|---|
| Raw | Source CCHS `.sav` files for two pooled cycles |
| Ferry output | Staging SQLite + raw Parquet backup |
| Ellis output | Analysis-ready Parquet tables + SQLite |
| Clarity layer | Optional split tables and data dictionary artifacts |

Detailed dataset definitions and diagnostics are documented in the pipeline manifests:

- [CACHE Manifest](../pipeline/cache-manifest.qmd)
- [INPUT Manifest](../pipeline/input-manifest.qmd)

## Authoring systems in this repository

- **Publishing Orchestra**: interviewer + writer workflow for frontend website assembly.
